retrieval_plan_assertions.explain_boundary: PostgreSQL represents SECURITY DEFINER SQL-function calls as a Function Scan. The gate therefore EXPLAINs the callable as the app role to prove the invocation boundary, then EXPLAINs the fingerprinted installed function body with its owner/RLS semantics to assert nested search_chunks plan nodes.
